CREATE TABLE screen_context_activity_meta (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version=1),
      epoch TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(epoch)=32))

CREATE TABLE screen_context_activity_revocations (
      segment_uid TEXT NOT NULL, from_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, to_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY(segment_uid, from_ms, to_ms),
      CHECK(typeof(from_ms)='integer' AND typeof(to_ms)='integer'
            AND from_ms>=0 AND to_ms<= 253402300799999 AND from_ms<to_ms))

CREATE TRIGGER screen_context_activity_update
      AFTER UPDATE ON activity_segments WHEN OLD.origin_device_id IS NULL
      AND length(OLD.segment_uid)=36 AND (
        OLD.segment_uid IS NOT NEW.segment_uid OR OLD.platform IS NOT NEW.platform OR OLD.source IS NOT NEW.source OR OLD.bundle_id IS NOT NEW.bundle_id OR OLD.window_title IS NOT NEW.window_title OR OLD.origin_device_id IS NOT NEW.origin_device_id OR OLD.exclusion_source IS NOT NEW.exclusion_source OR OLD.engagement_evidence IS NOT NEW.engagement_evidence OR OLD.confidence IS NOT NEW.confidence OR OLD.started_at IS NOT NEW.started_at
        OR screen_end_shrunk(OLD.ended_at, NEW.ended_at)) BEGIN
      SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM screen_context_activity_meta
    WHERE id=1 AND version=1 AND length(epoch)=32) != 1
    THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'screen activity fence unavailable') END;
      INSERT OR IGNORE INTO screen_context_activity_revocations
        SELECT OLD.segment_uid, 0, 253402300799999
        WHERE OLD.segment_uid IS NOT NEW.segment_uid OR OLD.platform IS NOT NEW.platform OR OLD.source IS NOT NEW.source OR OLD.bundle_id IS NOT NEW.bundle_id OR OLD.window_title IS NOT NEW.window_title OR OLD.origin_device_id IS NOT NEW.origin_device_id OR OLD.exclusion_source IS NOT NEW.exclusion_source OR OLD.engagement_evidence IS NOT NEW.engagement_evidence OR OLD.confidence IS NOT NEW.confidence OR screen_ceil_ms(OLD.started_at) IS NULL OR screen_ceil_ms(NEW.started_at) IS NULL OR screen_ceil_ms(OLD.ended_at) IS NULL OR screen_ceil_ms(NEW.ended_at) IS NULL;
      INSERT OR IGNORE INTO screen_context_activity_revocations
        SELECT OLD.segment_uid, screen_ceil_ms(OLD.started_at), screen_ceil_ms(NEW.started_at)
        WHERE screen_ceil_ms(NEW.started_at)>screen_ceil_ms(OLD.started_at);
      INSERT OR IGNORE INTO screen_context_activity_revocations
        SELECT OLD.segment_uid, screen_ceil_ms(NEW.ended_at), screen_ceil_ms(OLD.ended_at)
        WHERE screen_ceil_ms(NEW.ended_at)<screen_ceil_ms(OLD.ended_at);
      
    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO screen_context_activity_revocations
      SELECT OLD.segment_uid, 0, 253402300799999 WHERE
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM screen_context_activity_revocations WHERE segment_uid=OLD.segment_uid) > 64;
    DELETE FROM screen_context_activity_revocations WHERE segment_uid=OLD.segment_uid
      AND NOT (from_ms=0 AND to_ms=253402300799999)
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM screen_context_activity_revocations WHERE segment_uid=OLD.segment_uid
                  AND from_ms=0 AND to_ms=253402300799999);
    UPDATE screen_context_activity_meta SET epoch=lower(hex(randomblob(16)))
      WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM screen_context_activity_revocations) > 65536;
    DELETE FROM screen_context_activity_revocations WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM screen_context_activity_revocations) > 65536;
 END
